[b]December 28, 2026: Report on the State of the National Defense Forces & Future Strategies to Combat Waste and Bloat (Declassified)[/b]

The armed forces of Thýven, known as the National Defense Forces, stand as a large and well trained body under the banner of federalisation, with strong loyalty to the state being reported by the SCSI. 

However, the former leadership of the government (namely the empire and the patriarchate) heavily over-extended the realistic capabilities of the forces, straining the system which had not seen an internal reform of structure since the 1950s. 

As a result of this failure, the armed forces, while outwardly capable and well equipped, remain internally inefficient and bloated. This report shall provide recommendations to the First Council for their continuing work on reforming and restructuring the NDF.

[i]1. New Mission Objectives[/i]
As Thýven has continued its march into the 21st century, the overall objectives of the armed forces have clearly shifted from their original stance under the 1896 declaration of neutrality, moving from a position of defender, to a position of active international power. This power was displayed most effectively in the 2020-2025 Sal-Baliz War when the armed forces coordinated with fellow THEP allies the takedown of the Sal-Baliz terrorist group. 

As a result the still present mission objective of defense of the state must be broadened to include Thývens international obligations. 

[i] 2. Organisation under Federal Provisions[/i]

Prior to the declaration of federation (December 2, 2026 & December 5, 2026) the armed forces unofficially comprised three main components, the Imperial Defense Force, the National Defense Force, and the various princely levies. As the Imperial Defense Force has been folded into the operations of the SCSI and the levies have shown themselves to be weapons against order, the First Council must ensure that the army is unified fully without any compromise to the federalised states. The necessary steps  must be taken quickly to ensure unity of force, as the international scene has seen major shifts in terms of arms and military operations abroad. 

[i] 3. THEP integration[/i]

The armed forces of Thýven, despite having been a part of THEP since its founding, have still not undertaken the necessary steps or measures to integrate themselves into the unified command of THEP, primarily due to cultural differences and seperate strategic priorities. However as made in point 1, the new mission of the armed forces encompasses both internal and external projection. As such the First Council is advised to take the steps to ensure further unity of forces with the overall forces of THEP through gear, weaponry, and arms overall. Unified training across THEP and with all THEP allies should be pursued.

[i] 4. The Revolutionary Mandate[/i]

As noted by Piter Drømm in his earlier addresses to the nation, and affirmed by Erjk Malben, the state of Thýven now sits under a clear new revolutionary mandate, devolved to the hands of the people who support the central government. Thus under this new mandate, the First Council must ensure all military objectives follow the line of the revolution and of the orders of the Chairman of the First Council. The Revolutionary Mandate is the second most sacred mandate after the mandate of faith, and it shall be the capstone to an efficient and streamlined force.


[quote=pantagruel;60778278][i]Valddera's critical remarks shocked Daesun, a international pariah that had catered to genocidal communists could had no right to label Daesun as a traitor. An official response would be made to the Valdderan public about Valddera's imperialist sights on East Shamat. Daesun would also dispatch a warning to Hydronia and other nations deployed in Valddera demanding an immediate withdrawal, warning them about Daesun's future Bombardment of the Valdderan mainland. 

In the skies, the aerial battle was a complete overkill. The Daesunite air force received complete control of the Valdderan skies within 24 hours, but even with this assuring factor, the clouds were still dangerous. Valdderan air defenses that survived the initial bombing campaign leered in full force, proving to be a problem with actually carrying out any ground assaults. To combat this, Daesun focused on conducting precise ground strikes on remaining SAMs and air defences. A layered offensive strategy was instated, once a active SAM was detected by a AWAC or reconaissance drone, the coordinates and wavelength band of the system was uplinked to a local EA-18G, which focused on jamming and disrupting these systems before they could direct an attack. While the distraction ensued, F-15's were dispatched to the flash zone to operate a direct delivery drop off of JDAMs onto the targets. These were intended to strike with surgical precision, and leave Valdderan air defences constantly on the run.

In the vast expanses of the Northern sea, Valddera owned two major islands that proved strategically priceless if Daesun wanted to proliferate its influence in the artic. And so they were also listed onto the chopping block, Daesun dispatched its North Sea Strike Force 1, also known as NSTF-1 to the islands, accompanied by marines who travelled on LCU's and other watercraft. NSTF-1 consisted of 1 Virginia-class submarine, 3 Independence-class LCS, 2 Arleigh Burke-class destroyers, and 1 Antonio-class LPD, which acted as the command ship of the task force. Daesun had only one strategy in mind, striking as quickly as possible before local Valdderan military could reciprocate. Leading the pack of the task force was the single Virginia class submarine, staying submerged under the vast abyss, it stayed over 14 hours  ahead of its comrades. She was tasked with carrying out a lightning strike to disorient local Valdderan forces, while also making way for her partners. Analyzing the islands, the Virginia-class would search for Valdderan coastal artillery, SAM positions, minefields, communication nodes, and enemy radar signatures. Collected intel was put up on a broad information sharing band, allowing for the rest of the task force to listen in on what the Virginia class had found out. But information wasn't the only thing she seeked, her first objective still wasn't completed. Once the her armaments were within range of the Valdderan islands, the attack submarine would launch a fury of Tomohawk missiles, each streaking towards sophisticated high value targets such as coastal radars, C2 bunkers, and long range SAM sites. In total, a volley of 8 tomahawks screamed towards Valddera, each getting closer and closer as seconds passed by, the Valdderans only had so much time to effectively respond. Immediately after her assault, the Virginia class would resubmerge into low depth to wait for the rest of NSTF-1 to catch up, re-initiating its stealth to avoid detecting. Her attack was only the beginning, and paled in comparison to what awaited Valddera. 

But there was also another target that caught Daesun's eye, a pair of islands in the middle of the Shamite sea, two that were crucial in proliferating Daesun's influence in the sea. Just south of the islands roared the Mugunghwa shield, a heavy naval task force that had just completed its service in Astanir, contributing to Nordiheim's defeat in the Argossia. Their attention now veered north, towards Valddera's claims. But there was one major problem, the shield had to carefully thread itself through THEP territory, as a major alliance competing with Daesun for influence in the Shamite sea, caution was a priority. Mugunghwa's route traversed through [nation]Blobon[/nation]ite and [nation]BR Bob[/nation]ian waters, carefully avoiding any confrontation with THEP. A warning was also dispatched to [nation]United Hydronia[/nation]ns residing within the archipelago near Valddera's claims of the shield's action in Valddera. 

Once within operating range of Valddera's claims, the shield began a multi-layered analyzation campaign of the island's geography, topography, military, and communication assets. Recon drones such as the RQ-4 and Orlan-10 drones were dispatched to the island to analyze data and then send it back to Mugunghwa for dissection. The operation had to be precise, as Daesun could not afford losing a global hawk to Valdderan air defences. While the Orlan-10s were inexpensive and numerous, allowing for Daesun to dispatch many. 

Back in the mainland, the long idle of the 103rd infantry regiment finally ceased. Once Daesun  achieved full aerial superiority and began an operation eliminating remaining air defences, the airborne assault force could now operate on reduced caution. To avoid direct confrontation with the Valdderan army, the regiment focused on achieving a massive airlift straight to the capital, where they could then seize control of the country and de-esculate the situation. A mix of heavy CH-47's and A-64's were manned to lead the assault, with the Apaches acting as a spearhead, focusing on direct attacks on potential ground threats. While the Chinooks were the soft underbelly, containing most of the regiment, they were the heavy transport of the regiment and therefore needed sufficient defence to ensure safety. 

With contest in Valdderan airspace completely obliterated, heavy bombing campaigns could also be placed into action. B-52s deployed from Persephone were dispatched to operational bombing campaigns deep within Valdderan territory. Still paranoid about Valddera's SAM capabilities, the bombers focused on standoff range bombing. The bombers would focus on striking heavy Valdderan military nodes like command centers and bunkers with their AGM-158 JASSM-ER stand off missiles.[/i][/quote]
